# Peak District evening walk

A short walk on 6 August, from Edale up to Grindslow Knoll and back.

## Route

About 6 km with 350 m of ascent. Meet at the Edale car park at 6pm.

## Bring

- A waterproof jacket
- A snack and some water

## Emergency contacts

- Club emergency phone, carried on every walk: 07700 900123
- Club first-aider: Tom Okafor, 07700 900456
- Mountain rescue: call 999, ask for the police, then mountain rescue
- Club secretary, not on the walk: Ann Price, 07700 900789
